svg.title: The finite-pair small-transport constant d > 0 depends only on G. Choose frame cutoffat most d/ colorScale. On an all-minimum patch use its center axial frame a and pair transports Wxyk = ax travel(x →y, k)a−1 y . Their matrix distance from identity is at most d. Transforming a competing frame by bxa−1 x identifies pair cost and original frame score. Every competitor can be left normalized without changing cost. Compactness of the finite product of G with its center fixed gives a normalized minimizer, pair uniqueness gives uniqueness modulo common left multiplication, and center value one removes it.
